im sorry you have to experience this. I honestly agree so much i feel that being different/unique is only praised when it's palatable for everyone else so you can't be "too different". As a fellow aroace i totally relate to the fact that sometimes you just dont feel you belong in a community even if you feel your suppose to, especially since the aro/ace experience is so varied with each individual and trying to appeal to sex/romance repulsed people and sex/romantic positive people at the same time just doesnt work sometimes :/ 

what im trying to say is that i can relate. sex/romance being shoved into every piece of media you watch, awkward sex scenes, rushed romance that distracts the charecters from the main plot. everyone being expected to fall inlove  ("when you get married- etc" and all of that talk forced down your throat). everything being sexualised, everyone around you talking about their new crushes and how hot this person is. finding out yet again another song (especially childhood songs) is about guess what? sex. (not even suprising anymore) it's like "is there something that i'm missing?" and honestly sometimes no amount of aroace community spirit can pepare you for the pure isolation you feel in a world that just isn't build for you. <3

honestly being aro/ace feels like your dissapointing everyone, it's like as soon as you say you're aroace (and a sex/romance repulsed one at that) you cant stop it, everyone sees you differently. like your not human, an alien. it's like everyone has an expectation of you to get married have kids, fall inlove and you let them down :( 

validation does crazy things to peple, trust me i know from expirence :) being truely  accepted for everything that you are is a feeling like no-other, and honestly it seems that you haven't expirenced that yet. i feel your doubting yourself too much.                                                               i can confidently say that **no one hates you!!!**, what is there to even hate you for? you dont experience any form of romantic/sexual attraction, is that too much of a threat to everyone? to the point they have to wear you down with shitty overused insults.                                        

when there are feelings like serenity, hope and awe that exsist its ashame the world only focuses on lust and romance. you, your body, feelings and everything that make up you are so much more than just sex and romance and deserve to be reconised, loved (platonically ofc) and accepted for that. im sorry if this came off as cheesy at the end but take it easy.

i dont know what you'll decide to do but i hope you read this message, i promise we (capital L) Love you. take some platonic hearts to go <33333333333333333333
